bkms.name: calculateAgeInYears
bkms.feelBody: if targetDate = null or referenceDate = null then null else if date(targetDate) = null or date(referenceDate) = null then null else if date(targetDate) > date(referenceDate) then -1 else years and months duration(date(targetDate), date(referenceDate)).years

bkms.name: countRecentClaims
bkms.feelBody: if claimDates = null or referenceDate = null or windowMonths = null then null else if date(referenceDate) = null then null else count((for d in claimDates return if d = null then null else if date(d) = null then null else if date(d) >= (date(referenceDate) - duration("P" + string(windowMonths) + "M")) and date(d) <= date(referenceDate) then d else null)[item != null])

decisions.name: DriverRiskAssessment
decisions.label: Driver Risk Assessment
decisions.description: Computes the applicant driver risk classification (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, INELIGIBLE, or UNKNOWN) from driver age derived via BKM01 using dateOfBirth and evaluationDate.

rules.annotation: Missing or malformed DOB or evaluationDate -> unknown driver risk
Explicit invalid future DOB sentinel (-1) -> ineligible (never treated as valid age)
Underage applicant (<17 Indonesian SIM A/C minimum per UU No. 22/2009 Art. 81(2)(a)) -> ineligible
Young driver (17-24 inclusive) -> high risk
Prime adult driver (25-65 inclusive) -> low risk
Senior driver (>65) -> medium risk

decisions.name: ClaimsRiskAssessment
decisions.label: Claims Risk Assessment
decisions.description: Computes prior claims frequency risk (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, or UNKNOWN) from claimsHistoryAvailable and 24-month claims counted via BKM02 from claimDates and evaluationDate.

rules.annotation: Missing or false claimsHistoryAvailable -> UNKNOWN (never treated as clean)
Null claimDates or missing evaluationDate -> UNKNOWN
Verified history with 0 claims in last 24 months
Verified history with 1 claim in last 24 months
Verified history with >= 2 claims in last 24 months

decisions.name: VehicleEligibilityAssessment
decisions.label: Vehicle Eligibility Assessment
decisions.description: Computes technical vehicle insurability (ELIGIBLE or INELIGIBLE) from vehicleType, vehicle age via BKM01 (vehicleManufactureDate, evaluationDate), engineCC, and invalid non-positive insuredValue.

rules.annotation: Unsupported or null vehicle type
Missing manufacture or evaluation date
Invalid future manufacture date
Very old vehicle (> 15 completed years)
Missing or non-positive engine displacement
Invalid non-positive insured value (null deferred to D10 quote readiness)
Valid vehicle type, age <= 15 years, positive cc, and non-invalid valuation

decisions.name: VehicleRiskAssessment
decisions.label: Vehicle Risk Assessment
decisions.description: Computes vehicle technical risk tier (LOW, MEDIUM, or HIGH) from vehicleType, engineCC, performanceClass, and vehicle age derived via BKM01.

rules.annotation: Conservative HIGH guard for missing/invalid vehicleType
Conservative HIGH guard for missing/non-positive engineCC
Conservative HIGH guard for missing/invalid performanceClass
Conservative HIGH guard for missing/future vehicleAge (-1)
High-performance classification always yields HIGH vehicle risk
Large-displacement motorcycle (> 250cc)
Large-displacement car (> 2500cc)
Mid-size sport motorcycle (>150-250cc + SPORT)
Mid-size motorcycle (150-250cc)
Mid-size car (1500-2500cc)
Sport trim on compact engine
Aging vehicle (> 10 years)
Standard compact vehicle aged <= 10 years
Conservative fallback for missing/invalid vehicle attributes

decisions.name: UnderwritingDecision
decisions.label: Underwriting Decision
decisions.description: Computes the underwriting risk disposition (ACCEPT, REFER, or DECLINE) solely from D01 (driverRisk), D02 (claimsRisk), D03 (vehicleEligibility), and D04 (vehicleRisk), independent of commercial coverType.

rules.annotation: Hard eligibility gate: ineligible vehicle always declined
Hard eligibility gate: underage/ineligible driver declined
Extreme compound risk (young + >=2 claims + high-risk vehicle)
Missing driver DOB -> refer for identity/age verification
Missing claims history -> refer (never auto-accept)
High claims frequency (>=2 recent claims) -> senior review
Young driver with high-risk/high-performance vehicle
Young driver with recent claim history
All remaining eligible, verified, acceptable risk profiles
Defensive fallback for unexpected state

decisions.name: InspectionDecision
decisions.label: Inspection Decision
decisions.description: Determines whether pre-cover physical vehicle inspection is required (REQUIRED, NOT_REQUIRED, or NOT_APPLICABLE) from D05 (underwritingDecision), insuredValue, coverType, and vehicle age via BKM01.

rules.annotation: Declined policies do not undergo inspection
High-value vehicle (>= Rp500M) always requires physical inspection
Older vehicle (>10 years) requesting Comprehensive cover requires inspection
Standard-value vehicle within normal age
Older TPO policy below Rp500M does not require own-damage inspection
Conservative fallback requiring inspection when valuation or cover data is incomplete

decisions.name: BasePremiumCalculation
decisions.label: Base Premium Calculation
decisions.description: Computes the illustrative annual base premium in IDR (or null when pricing inputs are incomplete or invalid) from vehicleType, engineCC, coverType, and insuredValue.

rules.annotation: Safety guard: missing or non-positive insuredValue returns null (never Rp0 fallback)
MC <=150cc TPO: 0.5%, floor Rp150k
MC <=150cc Comp: 2.0%, floor Rp300k
MC 151-250cc TPO: 0.7%, floor Rp200k
MC 151-250cc Comp: 2.5%, floor Rp450k
MC >250cc TPO: 1.0%, floor Rp350k
MC >250cc Comp: 3.2%, floor Rp750k
Car <=1500cc TPO: 0.4%, floor Rp500k
Car <=1500cc Comp: 1.8%, floor Rp1.5M
Car 1501-2500cc TPO: 0.5%, floor Rp650k
Car 1501-2500cc Comp: 2.2%, floor Rp2.0M
Car >2500cc TPO: 0.6%, floor Rp850k
Car >2500cc Comp: 2.8%, floor Rp2.5M
Uncalculable fallback for missing, empty, or unsupported vehicleType, engineCC, or coverType (returns null, never Rp0)

decisions.name: RiskLoadingCalculation
decisions.label: Risk Loading Calculation
decisions.description: Computes the total additive risk loading fraction by summing independent surcharges from D01 (driverRisk), D02 (claimsRisk), D04 (vehicleRisk), and performanceClass.

rules.annotation: Young driver loading (+25%)
Senior driver loading (+10%)
No driver surcharge (or handled by decline/refer)
1 recent claim loading (+20%)
2+ recent claims loading (+40%)
Missing claims history provisional loading (+25%)
Clean claims record (+0%)
Medium vehicle technical risk loading (+10%)
High vehicle technical risk loading (+20%)
Low vehicle technical risk (+0%)
Sport trim surcharge (+15%)
High-performance surcharge (+30%)
Standard performance class (+0%)
Conservative fallback (+30%) for missing/invalid performance class

decisions.name: QuoteReadinessAssessment
decisions.label: Quote Readiness Assessment
decisions.description: Determines commercial and technical quotation readiness (READY, PENDING_INFORMATION, INVALID_INPUT, or NOT_APPLICABLE) from D05 (underwritingDecision), vehicleType, engineCC, coverType, insuredValue, and D07 (basePremium).

rules.annotation: Declined risk is excluded from commercial quotation
Missing or blank vehicleType prevents tariff lookup
Missing engineCC prevents tariff lookup
Missing or empty coverType -> pending quote while risk decision stays independent
Missing insuredValue -> pending quote without numeric fallback
Unsupported non-empty vehicleType
Non-positive engineCC cannot yield a valid tariff
Unsupported non-empty coverType cannot yield a default tariff
Non-positive insuredValue cannot yield a valid tariff
Intermediate basePremium calculation unavailable or non-positive
All required pricing inputs valid and basePremium calculated
Defensive fallback for unexpected state

decisions.name: FinalPremiumCalculation
decisions.label: Final Premium Calculation
decisions.description: Computes the approved annual final premium in IDR strictly when D05 is ACCEPT, D10 (quoteReadiness) is READY, and D07 (basePremium) is positive (applying D08 totalRiskLoading), otherwise returning null.

rules.annotation: Declined risk never produces an issued final premium (null)
Referred risk never automatically produces an approved final quotation (null)
Incomplete or invalid pricing inputs prevent final premium calculation (null)
Defensive guard: null or non-positive basePremium returns null
Approved policy premium with additive risk loading
Defensive fallback returning null

feelExpressionsCatalog.purpose: Inclusive closed-interval check classifying licensed young drivers aged 17 to 24.
Validates supported vehicle category and checks membership in sporty performance tiers.
Applies built-in max() for minimum tariff floor and decimal(..., 0) for IEEE-754-safe integer IDR rounding.

feelExpressionsCatalog.expression: if targetDate = null or referenceDate = null then null else if date(targetDate) > date(referenceDate) then -1 else years and months duration(date(targetDate), date(referenceDate)).years
feelExpressionsCatalog.purpose: Exact calendar-year age using years-and-months duration with null and future-date (-1) guards.
Counts historical claims within an exact 24-month calendar lookback ending on evaluationDate.

tests.name: Before, exact 24M anniversary, and 1 day older

feelExpressionsCatalog.location: D05/D09 integrated underwriting & quote gating logic
feelExpressionsCatalog.expression: if vehicleEligibility = "INELIGIBLE" or driverRisk = "INELIGIBLE" then "DECLINE" else if claimsRisk = "UNKNOWN" or driverRisk = "UNKNOWN" or claimsRisk = "HIGH" or (driverRisk = "HIGH" and (vehicleRisk = "HIGH" or claimsRisk = "MEDIUM")) then "REFER" else "ACCEPT"
feelExpressionsCatalog.purpose: Demonstrates hierarchical compound boolean logic enforcing DECLINE > REFER > ACCEPT.

testCases.name: Normal Acceptance — Prime Adult Standard Car (Comprehensive)
Borderline Thresholds — Age 24 (1 Day Before 25), Vehicle Age 15, 250cc Motorcycle
High Risk Referral — Young Driver + 1 Recent Claim + 600cc High-Performance Motorcycle
Decline — Very Old Vehicle (16 Years > 15-Year Maximum)
Edge Case — Missing Claims History + High-Value TPO (Rp550M)
Edge Case — Exact Inspection Value Threshold (Rp500M) + 2500cc Sport Car
Edge Case — Exact 24-Month Claim Boundary + Senior Driver + 150cc MC TPO Floor
Compound Extreme Risk Decline — Young + 2 Recent Claims + 251cc Sport Motorcycle
Edge Case — Underage Driver (Age 16 < 17 Minimum SIM Age)
Edge Case — Missing Date of Birth (Null DOB -> Refer, No Approved Final Quote)
Regression — Missing Cover Type (null -> Risk ACCEPT Separated from PENDING_INFORMATION Quote)
Regression — Unsupported Cover Type (INVALID_INPUT, No Rp0 Fallback)
Regression — Empty Cover Type (Blank String -> PENDING_INFORMATION, No Rp0 Fallback)
Regression — Valid COMPREHENSIVE Coverage (Ready & Positive Calculable Premium)
Regression — Valid THIRD_PARTY_ONLY Coverage (Ready & Positive Calculable Premium)
Regression — Missing Insured Value (null -> PENDING_INFORMATION, No Numeric Premium)
Regression — Declined Application (Underage Driver -> NOT_APPLICABLE & Null Final Premium)
Regression — Referred Application (2 Recent Claims -> No Auto-Approved Final Premium)
Regression — Missing Insured Value with TPO (Inspection Remains REQUIRED, Readiness PENDING_INFORMATION, Premium null)
